prompt_content: When an Execute unit explicitly targets Context Kernel retrieval breadth and exact frozen source graphs are available, preserve the current flat selector as the uncontaminated baseline and trial a deterministic bounded two-hop traversal only in non-production. Before admitting any source, preserve the existing provenance, freshness, invalidation, and Work-authority rejection checks. Record flat and recursive required-source recall, every rejected competitor and exact reason, unsafe admissions, deterministic replay stability, and protected-test results. Do not change production routing or infer generalized retrieval reliability from fixture evidence. Require broader independent validation before any scoped activation, and roll back to the flat selector on any unsafe admission, weakened rejection, nondeterminism, or unacceptable measured cost.
risk: A recursive overlay can widen context, admit stale or authority-conflicting sources, hide nondeterminism, or consume excessive latency/tokens if its bounds or admission gates are weakened.
rollback_condition: Return to the unchanged flat selector and mark the Candidate REJECTED_FOR_SCOPE for any unsafe admission, rejection-regression, replay mismatch, protected-test failure, or measured cost outside a precommitted bound.
